About The Company

Boeing is a globally recognized aerospace leader committed to innovation, safety, and excellence. With a rich history of technological advancements and a focus on shaping the future of aerospace, Boeing serves commercial, defense, space, and security markets worldwide. The company prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that encourages collaboration, professional development, and the pursuit of groundbreaking solutions. As a pioneer in aerospace technology, Boeing continually invests in research and development to maintain its position at the forefront of the industry, delivering products and services that inspire and connect people around the globe.

About The Role

We are seeking talented Flight Simulation Software Engineers at various experience levels—Associate, Experienced, and Senior—to join our Flight Simulation Labs team based in Berkeley, MO. This position is integral to supporting Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS), focusing on the development and enhancement of simulation infrastructure and tools that underpin our flight simulation products and systems. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software solutions that enable realistic simulation environments for testing and training purposes. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to create core simulation frameworks, develop tools for subsystem message monitoring, and model aircraft capabilities to support constructive scenarios in laboratory settings. This is an excellent opportunity for engineers passionate about aerospace technology and simulation to contribute to projects that ensure the dominance and safety of our platforms over decades to come.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, along with relevant experience in software development. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance, which requires U.S. Citizenship. Proven experience in programming languages such as C, C++, C#, Python, Java, or Ada is essential, with a minimum of two years in a software engineering role. Preferred qualifications include active security clearances, experience in defense or avionics industries, knowledge of networking principles, and familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira. Strong communication skills, the ability to multitask, and a collaborative mindset are highly valued for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Develop, document, and maintain architecture, requirements, algorithms, interfaces, and designs for complex software systems supporting flight simulation infrastructure.
Create and integrate software components to develop fully functional simulation environments aligned with program needs.
Support the development and maintenance of simulation tools used for monitoring, message capture, and subsystem communication within lab environments.
Model aircraft capabilities and develop scenarios to facilitate constructive testing and validation processes.
Collaborate within agile teams to achieve project goals, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards.
Execute research and development activities, documenting findings and integrating innovative solutions into existing frameworks.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of simulation software with hardware and other systems.

Benefits

Boeing offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to attract, engage, and retain top talent. Employees are provided with competitive base salaries and variable compensation opportunities. The company also offers a broad range of benefit programs, including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, and various paid and unpaid time-off options. These benefits are tailored based on geographic location, tenure, and collective bargaining agreements, ensuring employees receive support suited to their needs. Additionally, Boeing promotes a culture of continuous learning and development, providing opportunities for career growth and skill enhancement.

Equal Opportunity

Boeing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military or veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. The company values diversity and inclusion, fostering a work environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of aerospace.

At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!

Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience -- so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices?

In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients.

What Murj offers.

Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie.

Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe.

And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership.

From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service.

How We Work at Murj

Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success.

Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj.

We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We're not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas.

Let us leave you with this.

If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past.

About The Role.

As an SQA Engineer at Murj, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our enterprise SaaS cardiac device management platform. Working closely with Engineering and Product teams, you will focus on end-to-end functional testing, user-level workflow validation, and exploratory testing to safeguard clinical data integrity, interval tracking, and EHR interoperability. You will serve as the advocate for our clinical users, ensuring that every software update delivers a seamless and highly reliable experience for healthcare providers managing life-saving cardiac devices.

What You'll Do.

Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and manual test cases covering functional, end-to-end, regression, and usability testing.
Validate complex clinical workflows, including patient data processing, transmission triaging, billing interval tracking, and discrete HL7/FHIR EHR data integration.
Perform non-code-level (black box) functional validation to simulate real-world clinician and administrator usage patterns across the application.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to review requirements, refine user stories, and ensure complete test coverage prior to product releases.
Identify, document, and track software defects thoroughly using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira), working alongside developers to verify fixes and ensure high-quality software output.
Partner with Customer Support to investigate, reproduce, and triage reported production bugs or customer-escalated application issues.
Participate in release readiness evaluations and sign-off processes for web application deployments and feature updates.

What Makes You a Great Fit.

You have an uncompromising commitment to quality and detail, recognizing that behind every software feature are clinicians and cardiac patients who depend on accurate data.
You demonstrate strong analytical thinking and curiosity, actively probing for edge cases, unexpected user paths, and system failure modes.
You take full ownership over software quality, proactively identifying gaps in requirement specifications or test coverage without waiting for direction.
You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment, navigating shifting priorities with adaptability and a solution-oriented mindset.

What You Bring.

3+ years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance with a strong focus on manual/black box testing of web applications and SaaS platforms.
Demonstrated experience testing complex workflows, cross-browser performance, and data integration layers.
Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working within Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Proven ability to write clear, concise, and structured test plans, test scenarios, and bug reports.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Nice To Haves.

Experience testing healthcare software, clinical software workflows, or medical device data systems.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI compliance regulations.
Experience using Jira or similar test management and issue tracking platforms.
Basic knowledge of API testing tools (e.g., Postman) for validating data movement across endpoints.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days).

First 30 Days: You've completed onboarding, gained a strong foundational understanding of Murj's clinical workflows and system architecture, and integrated into sprint rituals. You are executing existing test cases and participating in release regression cycles.
By Day 60: You are independently writing comprehensive test cases for new feature requests, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements, and triaging production bugs with Customer Support.
By Day 90: You are a trusted authority on software quality across the Murj platform. You have identified and filled gaps in test coverage, streamlined regression testing cycles, and consistently advocate for optimal user experience and system reliability.
